description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.
